caption:
Connectors are the best way to make the most of Claude - to fetch data from internal tools just by giving access. 

If you want to start using connectors , you can simply go to Claude in the chat version - go to the plus button, and choose connectors.

After that you will be able to access connectors . Now you need to choose the connectors and sign in with the requisite id. 

If you are on level 1, then these are 3 you need to get started:

1. Google Drive - use it to fetch data from drive , google sheets, google docs using simple prompts 
2. Google calendar - access and manage your calendar using Claude 
3. Gmail - Nikhil Kamath’s fav use case - tells you all the important mails .
